backgrounds: Single set: a stop-motion (felt/wool puppet style) modern apartment kitchen, shot from a fixed-ish camera angle with a shallow depth of field that keeps the background softly blurred. Visible elements include wood-grain upper and lower cabinets with brushed-metal handles, a stainless steel stove hood and gas stovetop, a white refrigerator, a stainless steel sink with faucet, grey/marble-look countertops, and a large window with cream trim looking out onto a blurred brick apartment building across the street (daytime, soft natural light). No scene changes or second location occur within the episode; the only other 'background' is a plain solid black title/end-card frame with the show's yellow logotype and a 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' tag graphic.

lighting_notes: Soft, warm, naturalistic daylight appears to spill in from the large kitchen window, giving gentle highlights on the felt character skin and a bright but not harsh look overall. The background is consistently thrown out of focus (shallow depth of field), which combined with soft key light isolates the two characters in the foreground. Lighting stays constant throughout since it's a single continuous scene; the only lighting shift is the hard cut to a flat black title card with no gradient.
color_palette: single bright yellow logo/graphic accent on black card
visual_complexity_notes: The kitchen set is moderately detailed and lived-in (appliances, plant, knife block, towel) but rendered with soft focus and muted, harmonious tones so it reads as a believable domestic backdrop without competing with the characters. Camera stays close on the two puppet characters' exaggerated long-nosed faces for almost the entire runtime, so despite the set having real depth and clutter, the effective on-screen complexity is low and deliberately keeps focus on facial expressions and dialogue; only a stark flat black end card is genuinely minimal.
